anomalies.observed: U2 pin 1 (RO) is connected to NET00061, while the M-BUS UART receive connection at pin 16 of J9 and J7 is NET0006. These are different nets, so the transceiver receive output is not connected to the M5Stack UART RX line.
anomalies.expected: U2 RO should connect to the M5Stack UART RXD2 net so the host can receive data from the serial servo bus.

evidence.quote: U2 pin 1 RO — NET00061; J9 pin 16 — NET0006; J7 pin 16 — NET0006 (page 1).
“U1 (MAX3485) ... fed from the M5Stack's PortC UART (/TXD2//RXD2, J1/J2 pins 15/16)” (§3).

anomalies.impact: The M5Stack may transmit commands to serial servos, but it will not receive their replies. Serial-servo feedback and response-dependent behavior will fail.

parsed.summary: The schematic leaves the MAX3485 receive output on NET00061, separate from the M-BUS UART RX net NET0006. This breaks the serial-servo receive path.
